provenance.construction: Two-block group algebra (2BGA) over the affine group of F_19: metacyclic(q, q-1, primitive_root) with left-support a=[294, 208, 142, 284] and right-support b=[6, 323, 76, 217]. Built via the research/kit group_algebra build_2bga sampler (sample_kasai_affine, seed=17).
provenance.notes: Distance is an UPPER BOUND from randomized lightest-logical witness searches. The original d=100 claim (PR #224) was REFUTED by CI: the syndrome-decoder pass found a weight-97 X-logical and the accelerated RIS-fast pass (8M trials) found a weight-85 X-logical, both lighter than 100. This submission corrects the claim to the honest minimum found: d_X <= 85 (RIS-fast witness), d_Z <= 104 (original witness). d = min = 85. Both witnesses are validated against the pinned python stack (gf2.logical_basis / commutes / in_rowspace).
